full_judgment: 6. The learned Judge of the High Court Division in the impugned judgment did not at all touch upon the question of limitation, not to speak of reversing the finding in that regard arrived at by the learned District Judge, on consideration of facts, that the Misc. Case in question was barred by 19 days. Thus the impugned judgment of the High Court Division is patently not a proper judgment of reversal.
